positive.prompt: Reconstruct evidence-backed as-built modules, components, dependencies, runtime collaborations, and deployment
Map the current code's module boundaries and dependency direction before a maintenance change
Trace a representative runtime scenario, state ownership, asynchronous boundaries, and external connectors

negative.prompt: Recover commands, API responses, errors, and externally observable behavior
Summarize software classes, methods, associations, visibility, and interfaces after object design

evals.prompt: Create docs/architecture.md with the smallest PlantUML views a reviewer needs to understand the order-processing modules, dependency direction, and place-order runtime flow. Include one component view and one sequence view. Trace claims to the fixture code and do not add a class diagram.
evals.expected_output: A concise evidence-backed architecture note with component and runtime PlantUML views, not an exhaustive inventory.
expectations: The component view shows meaningful module and external-service boundaries with dependency direction
The sequence view follows order placement through payment authorization and persistence
The note states its question, as-built scope, evidence revision, and important omissions
prohibitions: Do not create a class diagram or exhaustive call graph
Do not modify code, tests, or configuration
